## `[tiers]`

Transfer limits of the tiered Flux Plugs and Points, in FE per tick.

### `[tiers.herculean]`

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultLimit` | `5000000` | 0 ~ 1000000000000000 | Transfer limit of a newly placed device |
| `maxLimit` | `20000000` | 1 ~ 1000000000000000 | Highest transfer limit of a device, "Disable Limit" included. At most 1000000000000000 so that Flux Networks' network sums cannot overflow |

### `[tiers.gargantuan]`

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultLimit` | `50000000` | 0 ~ 1000000000000000 | Transfer limit of a newly placed device |
| `maxLimit` | `200000000` | 1 ~ 1000000000000000 | Highest transfer limit of a device, "Disable Limit" included. At most 1000000000000000 so that Flux Networks' network sums cannot overflow |

### `[tiers.ultimate]`

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `maxLimit` | `1000000000000000` | 1 ~ 1000000000000000 | Highest transfer limit of a device, "Disable Limit" included. At most 1000000000000000 so that Flux Networks' network sums cannot overflow |

## `[basic]`

Flux Plugs and Points from Flux Networks itself

| Option | Default | Range or values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `capBasicDevices` | `false` |  | Cap the basic Flux Plugs and Points at basicMaxLimit, "Disable Limit" included, so that higher transfer rates need the tiered devices. Off by default: existing networks keep working as before. The limit set in each device is kept, so turning this off again restores it. |
| `basicMaxLimit` | `2500000` | 1 ~ 1000000000000000 | Highest transfer limit of a basic Flux Plug or Point when capBasicDevices is on |
